issues.display_title: Issue #350: Hotspot Validation Utility (ValidateHotspots) for Post APIs
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 11/06/26

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Implementation :

Description

Create a reusable validation utility at src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/HotspotValidation.go with a ValidateHotspots function to standardize hotspot rules across endpoints (AddPostCompleteV1 and EditHotspotBanner).

Rules enforced:

  • Allowed only for panorama / multiple post types
  • Maximum 5 hotspots per post
  • sequence required for multiple post types
  • type must be mention or content
  • content hotspots must have a non-empty title

Source spec: docs/brainstorm/2026-06-12-implementation-hotspot-banner.md (section 1).

🧪 Testing Scenarios (for QA)

  1. Submit exactly 5 hotspots → passes; submit 6 → rejected with hotspots-limit.
  2. Hotspot on a non-panorama/multiple post → rejected with invalid-post-type.
  3. multiple post hotspot without sequence → rejected with hotspot-sequence-required.
  4. Hotspot with a type other than mention/content → rejected with hotspot-type-invalid.
  5. content hotspot with empty/missing title → rejected with hotspot-title-required.
  6. Valid mention hotspot (no title required) → passes.

issues.display_title: Issue #351: API – Add Post Complete V1: Hotspot & Affiliate Banner Support
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 11/06/26

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Implementation :

Description

Integrate hotspot + affiliate validation into the post finalization flow in src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go (AddPostCompleteV1).

Scope:

  • Validate hotspots from the data payload via the shared ValidateHotspots utility before processing.
  • Verify the provided affiliate_id belongs to the authenticated user (id = ? AND user_id = ?).
  • Pass validated hotspot + affiliate data to the background worker for persistence.

Depends on: ValidateHotspots utility task. Source spec: docs/brainstorm/2026-06-12-implementation-hotspot-banner.md (section 2).

🧪 Testing Scenarios (for QA)

  1. Publish a panorama post with 3 valid hotspots → post + hotspots persisted by the worker.
  2. Publish with an affiliate owned by the user → posts.affiliate_id set correctly.
  3. Publish with an affiliate_id belonging to another user → rejected with affiliate-unauthorized.
  4. Publish with 6 hotspots → rejected before processing (hotspots-limit).
  5. Publish without hotspots/affiliate → succeeds, no regression to the existing flow.
  6. Verify the worker persists hotspots using delete-then-insert with no duplicates.

issues.display_title: Issue #352: API – Edit Hotspot & Affiliate Banner (POST /v1/posts/edit-hotspot-banner)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 12/06/26

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Route :

POST /posts/edit-hotspot-banner

Payload :

  • hotspots
  • affiliate_id

Example Payload :

{
    "hotspots": [
        {
            "sequence": 1,
            "type": "mention",
            "coordinates": {
                "x": 120,
                "y": 250
            },
            "data": {
                "username": "@[testpanorra](ec12fyh45h)"
            }
        },
        {
            "sequence": 1,
            "type": "content",
            "coordinates": {
                "x": 450,
                "y": 100
            },
            "data": {
                "title": "keren banget view-nya!",
                "description": "keren banget view-nya!",
                "cta_text": "klik disini",
                "url": "https://google.com"
            }
        },
        {
            "sequence": 1,
            "type": "mention",
            "coordinates": {
                "x": 600,
                "y": 300
            },
            "data": {
                "username": "@[ekosy](c92456e229a)"
            }
        },
        {
            "sequence": 2,
            "type": "content",
            "coordinates": {
                "x": 450,
                "y": 100
            },
            "data": {
                "title": "keren banget view-nya!",
                "description": "keren banget view-nya!",
                "cta_text": "klik disini",
                "url": "https://google.com"
            }
        },
        {
            "sequence": 3,
            "type": "mention",
            "coordinates": {
                "x": 120,
                "y": 250
            },
            "data": {
                "username": "@[testpanorra](ec12fyh45h)"
            }
        }
    ],
    "affiliate_id": "5247258d-fb7c-429e-b1e0-867dfb6ebbb5"
}

Implementation Payload :

Description

Add a new endpoint to edit hotspots and affiliate banner on already-published posts.

Files / Route:

  • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditHotspotBanner.go
  • Controller wrapper in src/Controllers/V1/PostsController.go
  • Route: POST /v1/posts/edit-hotspot-banner in src/Routes/V1/PostsRoutes.go

Behavior:

  • Ownership check — only the post owner can edit.
  • Atomic DB transaction: delete existing hotspots → batch insert new hotspots → update posts.affiliate_id.
  • Full-state replacement: filled = set; empty/absent = clear (hotspots all deleted, affiliate set to NULL).
  • Supports slug or id (sl=true query param) and ec=true encrypted response.
  • Reuses the shared ValidateHotspots utility.

Depends on: ValidateHotspots utility task. Source spec: docs/brainstorm/2026-06-12-implementation-hotspot-banner.md (section 3).

🧪 Testing Scenarios (for QA)

  1. Replace hotspots (3 → 2) on a panorama post → only the 2 new rows remain.
  2. Send empty/absent hotspots → all hotspots for the post are deleted.
  3. Submit 6 hotspots → 400 hotspots-limit, transaction rolls back (nothing changes).
  4. Swap affiliate to another affiliate owned by the user → posts.affiliate_id updated.
  5. Set affiliate on a previously-null post → succeeds (ownership gate only).
  6. Empty/absent affiliate_id → posts.affiliate_id becomes NULL.
  7. Affiliate owned by a different user → 403 affiliate-unauthorized.
  8. Edit a post not owned by the user → 409 Post Not Found.
  9. Combined new hotspots + new affiliate in one call → both applied atomically.
  10. sl=true resolves the post by id; default resolves by slug.
  11. ec=true → encrypted response payload returns correctly.
